launch.reason: Held (coordinator, 2026-11-19): independent review, external audit and the owner's key ceremony are pending for this route. No tool accepts it for deployment, signing or relaying.

verified.source: the asset is the network's native currency: no contract, no issuer. The vault's token() is the marker 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE (no code; eth_getCode read on a local fork of Ethereum in tools/native-ether/rehearse_fork.py)

unit.adapter: none: the vault itself counts units (contracts/eth/NativeEtherSourceVault.sol, UNIT)
unit.note: every amount of this file, of the vault and of the L2 token is in units of 1e12 wei (0.000001 ETH). A deposit sends exactly amount x 1e12 wei; a value that is not a whole number of units cannot be deposited

fee.collection: accrued in the vault outside the backing, in ether; anyone calls sweepFees() and the vault pays the recipient. Each fee is rounded UP to the unit (0.000001 ETH), never in the user's favour
fee.networkFee: the depositor pays the deposit transaction; the relayer pays the release transaction, up to 30 gwei: while the network's gas price is above that the release waits

finality.rule: A deposit is attested when its block is at or below the block the signer's own Ethereum node reports as finalized (two epochs of Ethereum's own consensus).
finality.reorg: Signers read only finalized blocks; a deposit that leaves the canonical chain before finality is never attested. Every mint waits 12 hours on the L2; the relayer does not execute a mint whose deposit is not in the vault's finalized deposit chain and the guardians cancel it. A credited mint with no deposit holds later releases instead of paying them.

deposit.recipientEncoding: bytes32: the 20-byte L2 address left-padded with zeros
steps: no approval: the asset is ether

call deposit(amount, l2Recipient) on the vault with value = amount x 1000000000000 wei exactly (amount is in units of 0.000001 ETH); any other value is refused (ValueMismatch) and nothing is ever refunded
state the L2 recipient explicitly, also when depositing from a smart-contract wallet: it is never taken from the sender
after source finality and the 12 hour mint delay the L2 token credits amount less 0.05% (rounded up to the unit) to l2Recipient
refusals: a plain transfer of ether to the vault (no deposit call): it reverts (DirectTransferRefused)
a value that is not exactly amount x 1e12 wei
an amount below minDeposit or above maxDeposit, or one that would pass the cap
an l2Recipient that is zero or longer than 20 bytes
do not name a contract as l2Recipient unless it can move the token

release.paysAsset: ether, the burned amount less 0.1% (rounded up to the unit), amount x 1e12 wei
notes: the vault pays by sending ether to sourceRecipient with 30,000 gas: a plain account and a smart-contract wallet whose receive function fits in that gas are paid at once

if sourceRecipient refuses ether or needs more gas, the release still completes and the payment waits in the vault: anyone calls claimFor(sourceRecipient) (all gas forwarded, paid to sourceRecipient only), or sourceRecipient itself calls claim(to) to send it to another address. The event ReleaseDeferred(id, recipient, amount) says so; a page must show it and offer the claim
a contract that can neither receive ether nor call claim(to) can never take its payment: do not name one. The burn names the recipient and cannot be redirected by anyone else
the relayer pays at most 30 gwei per gas: while the network's gas price is above that ceiling a release waits (it is not lost) and is paid when the price falls
the smallest exit is l2MinBurn (7 ETH): its 0.1% fee pays the relayer's worst-case release (227,000 gas) at the 30 gwei ceiling (docs/ETH-VAULT-DIFF.md section 5)

NOT LAUNCHABLE IN V1 (held): Held (coordinator, 2026-11-19): independent review, external audit and the owner's key ceremony are pending for this route. No tool accepts it for deployment, signing or relaying. A page, a pool builder or the DEX gate must not offer this route; every bridge tool refuses it (tools/signatario-stable/native_ether.py). The network's USDC route is another route with its own launch block.

UNAUDITED. Nothing is deployed. A further route of Ethereum: the network's first route is USDC (deployments/mainnet/). The custody contract is NativeEtherSourceVault (the Ethereum vault plus nine marked changes, docs/ETH-VAULT-DIFF.md); the L2 token is the frozen BridgedStablecoinV3, byte-identical.
bETH has SIX decimals: 1 bETH = 1 ETH, the smallest amount is 0.000001 ETH. Integrators must read decimals(); a pool or a page that assumes 18 decimals for an ether token misprices it by 1e12.

Limits are ether amounts sized on 2026-11-19 from the USD rule of that day for Ethereum USDC (cap 500,000 USD, window 50,000 USD per 24 h) at 1,777 USD per ETH (Coinbase 1,777.015 and Kraken 1,778.76, 03:32 UTC): cap 280 ETH, window 28 ETH per 24 h. They are immutable and float in USD with the price of ether: at twice the price the cap is 995,120 USD and the window 99,512 USD a day.

The vault's ether balance can exceed the cap by payments waiting for their recipients (totalClaimable) and by ether forced into it (surplusWei); neither is backing, neither is within the committee's reach.
